description: asdlc: install the command when a session starts, lint a document as soon as Claude writes it, and guard a branch before Claude pushes it

hooks.command: asdlc="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/asdlc/venv/bin/asdlc"; [ -x "$asdlc" ] || { echo 'asdlc: the command was not installed when this session started, so the guard did not run. Start a new session with uv installed and the network up' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$asdlc" hook run guard

asdlc="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/asdlc/venv/bin/asdlc"; [ -x "$asdlc" ] || { echo 'asdlc: the command was not installed when this session started, so the guard did not run. Start a new session with uv installed and the network up' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$asdlc" hook run guard

asdlc="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/asdlc/venv/bin/asdlc"; [ -x "$asdlc" ] || { echo 'asdlc: the command was not installed when this session started, so the linter did not run. Start a new session with uv installed and the network up' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$asdlc" hook run lint
